services.name: Dolphin Watch & Historical Harbor Sail
services.desc: Cruise and sail through the historic harbors near Vilano Beach, as we seek out some of Saint Augustine’s most charming residents, the local dolphin population. We’ll view local bottlenose dolphins as they frolic, feed, and engage in their natural behaviors. Guests will enjoy unobstructed views of the nation’s oldest city from the perfect vantage point, on the water. Fury’s state-of-the-art 65’ Sailing catamaran provides 360-degree views, as guests roam the spacious deck and open air cabin enjoying complimentary sodas, water, beer and wine. services.name: Live Music Sunset Sail & Nights of Lights Viewing
services.desc: See the historic cityscape come alive with holiday magic, during Saint Augustine’s Nights of Lights celebration. Winter wonderlands normally conjure images of snow and sleighs. We prefer a new take that includes gentle waves, pastel sunsets and soothing ocean breezes. Discover a new holiday tradition aboard Fury’s state-of-the-art 65’ Sailing Catamaran. Enjoy variety of complimentary snacks and drinks with live music, as you view the sunset over historic Saint Augustine. It’s the perfect prologue for the spectacular lights display that follows. Experience The Nights of Lights with a perfect view from Fury’s spacious deck. As the sun goes down, the fun just begins! Enjoy Live Music
